scope: Small fixed qualitative probes using pinned repository assets; no claim of an unseen benchmark. Visual reference facts were checked from actual pixels, not filenames. Audio prompts use clean waveform processing without training augmentation.

cases.prompt: Explain how to make a cup of coffee in one short sentence.

cases.reference_question: 请用一句话介绍一下春天

cases.prompt: 篮子里有哪些水果？简短回答。
